newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis mixed, focus on harvest.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis mixed, focus on harvest.

text.p: Cash soymeal markets were quiet Monday as crushers continued to wait for a jump in soybean supplies following a busy harvest weekend, dealers said.
"It's pretty quiet and we're not seeing a lot of activity," one Indiana dealer said. "It looks like they're (farmers) are putting soybeans in the bin at home."
Offers were mixed, with support stemming from "pretty good domestic demand," one dealer said.
One Indiana dealer noted a surge in supplies but said that buyers are watching CBOT futures to see if prices fall further before purchases were made.

Although rain was forecast for much of the Midwest late this week, one soymeal broker said several good days of harvest weather before the precipitation moves in would enable farmers to do enough harvesting that "we'll be able to get a better idea about yields."
